```{python}
#| tags: [hide-all]
import _helpers as h
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.io as pio

pio.templates.default = "plotly_white"

dmps = h.load_dmps()
erbs = h.load_erbs()

dept_data = {}
for dept in h.DEPARTMENTS:
    dd = h.filter_department(dmps, dept)
    de = h.department_erbs(dd, erbs)
    dept_data[dept] = {"dmps": dd, "erbs": de}
```

             hover_data=["DMPs", "Approved"], color="Department")

```{python}
#| echo: false
import pandas as pd
rows = []
for dept in h.DEPARTMENTS:
    sub = h.filter_department(dmps, dept)
    repo = h.repository_breakdown(sub)
    repo = repo[repo["Repository"] != "(none)"]
    for _, r in repo.iterrows():
        rows.append({"Department": dept, "Repository": r["Repository"], "DMPs": r["DMPs"]})
df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
fig = px.bar(df, x="DMPs", y="Repository", orientation="h",
             color="Department", barmode="group", height=500,
             title="Repository usage by department")
fig.update_layout(yaxis={"categoryorder": "total ascending"})
fig
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
import pandas as pd
rows = []
for dept in h.DEPARTMENTS:
    sub = h.filter_department(dmps, dept)
    arch = h.archive_breakdown(sub)
    for _, r in arch.iterrows():
        rows.append({"Department": dept, "Location": r["Location"], "DMPs": r["DMPs"]})
df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
fig = px.bar(df, x="DMPs", y="Department", color="Location",
             barmode="stack", height=450,
             title="Archive location by department")
fig
```

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  var sel = document.getElementById("dept-select");
  var panels = document.querySelectorAll(".dept-panel");
  function show(slug) {
    panels.forEach(function (p) { p.style.display = "none"; });
    var target = document.getElementById("dept-" + slug);
    if (target) target.style.display = "";
  }
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var init = params.get("dept");
  if (init) { sel.value = init; show(init); }
  else { show(sel.value); }
  sel.addEventListener("change", function () {
    show(this.value);
    params.set("dept", this.value);
    history.replaceState(null, "", "?" + params.toString());
  });
});
</script>
